content.short: ZettaBlock is a full-stack Web3 data and AI platform providing real-time indexing and the Kite AI network.
content.description:
ZettaBlock is a leading enterprise-grade decentralized data infrastructure designed to provide high-performance indexing and analytics for the global digital economy. The platform enables developers to unite real-time on-chain and off-chain data, allowing them to build and scale sophisticated decentralized applications with institutional-grade precision. ZettaBlock recently launched Kite AI, a decentralized foundation layer that empowers AI developers to collaboratively curate, manage, and monetize high-quality datasets and models.

By simplifying the complexities of blockchain data access, ZettaBlock provides builders with the essential tools needed to launch low-latency APIs and interactive dashboards in minutes. The network focuses on professional-grade transparency and data integrity, serving as a primary venue for cross-chain intelligence across networks like Ethereum, Polygon, and Solana. Through its commitment to technological innovation and the integration of decentralized AI, ZettaBlock is building the foundational framework for a more intelligent and meritocratic decentralized future.
